title: Guatemala: the armed conflict and the Maya people
goal: I can describe the armed conflict in Guatemala and what the commission found, using relative clauses.
grammar: Relative clauses with que and quien

items: I can describe the Guatemalan conflict and what the commission found, with relative clauses.
I can say what happened to the Maya communities between 1981 and 1983.
I can say who Rigoberta Menchú is and what she received.
I can use que and quien to add information about a person or thing.
I can use the new words for the highlands, the village and genocide.
